record.what_it_does: Gladly is a customer service/helpdesk platform providing a REST API to manage agents, conversations, customers, answers, tasks, and other support objects.
record.auth_notes: The core REST API uses token-based HTTP Basic Authentication (agent email as username, an admin-generated API token as password); an API User permission is required to create tokens. Separately, OAuth2 exists only for the Gladly 'App Platform' (embedded apps built with the appcfg CLI), and requires contacting Gladly Support to register the OAuth domain before use.
record.access_notes: Gladly has no public self-serve signup or free trial for API access; API tokens can only be created by an Administrator inside an existing (paid) Gladly organization account, and a dedicated user with the API User permission must first be provisioned. New prospects are directed to request a sales demo rather than sign up directly.
record.main_blocker: No self-serve signup or trial — API tokens require an existing paid Gladly org and admin-provisioned API User account
